content_of_post_to_answer: What should I do if every day is becoming repetitive?
answer: Repetition itself is not always the problem; often it is the absence of attention. The same routine can feel empty when you stop noticing, learning, or choosing within it. Before changing your entire life, ask whether you have become a passive observer of your own days. A meaningful life is not built only from new experiences, but from bringing a new level of awareness to ordinary ones.
